actual_behavior: Integer SHIELD_STRENGTH, default6, separate from MAX_HEALTH100. Each accepted break subtracts exactly1, independent of excess amount. Clone getter returns0. Boss bar in phase1 displays shield/current max_shield_strength, not HP.

Synched default6; constructor then stores int(attribute twilightforest:max_shield_strength), default6/range0..1024. clone_count defaults2 and minion_count9 (same attribute range). Constructor copies int(minion_count) to reserve. finalizeSpawn equips Fortification Scepter; it does not grant additional shields. NBT explicitly saves/restores shield/reserve/clone UUIDs/master/baby count/hit counter; missing integer keys read0. Setter has no clamp or native refill.

Only the non-bypassing shield branch with tagged source and raw incoming float amount>2 decrements1. All shield-branch exits return false. A failed tag/amount check may set lastHurtByMob from a Living causing entity; successful break branch does not do that. die can clear shield to0 but is not shield break.

breaks_lich_shields is necessary inside the ordinary shield branch but is NOT sufficient. Exactly five native values: twilightforest:lich_bolt, twilightforest:twilight_scepter, minecraft:magic, minecraft:indirect_magic, minecraft:sonic_boom. Bomb and neoforge:is_magic membership alone do not qualify. BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY skips the shield mechanism and attempts HP damage instead of decrementing.

To break normally: reach Lich.hurt through a legitimate delivery; teleport counter<=0; not a clone; causing entity not any Lich; shield>0; not bypassing invulnerability; tag match; argument strictly>2. No universal Player/direct-projectile/owner/nonally test is present in Lich.hurt. Projectile, potion, fang, Conduit and Warden predicates are separately retained in source_paths. Cloaked Bolt collision is rejected even before hurt.

A shield decrement, including6->5 and1->0, returns false without super.hurt: same request causes no HP loss, no hurt cooldown and no standard successful-hit callback. Separate later requests from one compound delivery can damage HP after1->0: ownerless Wither Skull magic5 can break, then its distinct native explosion request can hit exposed Lich. Multiple fangs/Anvil sweep+AoE similarly remain distinct requests. Damage requests are not measured HP loss.

At1->0 getPhase immediately becomes2 if reserve>0 or owned minion count>0; otherwise3. Default fresh Lich has reserve9, so phase2. No immediate HP damage, forced HP write or forced teleport is performed by shield break. Phase1 goal stops and despawns clones when goal scheduling observes loss of phase1; phase2 equips Zombie Scepter. Bossbar switches to HP on its next update.

effects.display_name: Lich HP admission and projectile defense
actual_behavior: Order: (1) teleport invisibility>0 rejects unless BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY; (2) exact IN_WALL with target attempts teleport; (3) clone rejects unless bypass; (4) causing entity instanceof Lich rejects unconditionally; (5) non-bypass and shield>0 performs tag/strict>2 counter logic and returns false; (6) otherwise BaseTFBoss/super.hurt; (7) only true super return can trigger randomized survival teleport, then true. BaseTFBoss has no hurt override. IN_WALL teleport can set invisibility during this call without rechecking the first gate.

getPhase: clone OR shield>0 =>1; else reserve<=0 AND countMyMinions()<=0 =>3; otherwise2. No HP threshold defines the three phases. countMyMinions scans AABB(x,y,z,x+1,y+1,z+1).inflate(32,16,32), master identity==this; no explicit alive filter. Nearby owned minions outside that box do not keep phase2 active.

Shielded non-bypass hits never enter LivingEntity.hurt. Armor, Resistance, protection, absorption, ordinary hurt cooldown, incoming/pre/post damage hooks and HP subtraction are not reached for this branch. A normal untagged sword/arrow/explosion fails; amount<=2 fails even if tagged. Lich.hurt itself does not first repeat vanilla dead/client/invulnerable checks before counter processing. Delivery APIs can have their own earlier gates.

Lich Bolt damage direct=this bolt, causing=current owner; optional excluded Lich EntityType affects death message only. Phase1 Bolt collision additionally requires owner instanceof Player; native Lich/clone-owned, ownerless and other-mob-owned bolts cannot collide with phase1 Lich. Local Bolt.canHitEntity does not call super: it excludes Bolt/Bomb/Wand targets and cloaked Lich, then allows other candidates; do not invent inherited owner-vehicle/pickability predicates. Wand does call super.canHitEntity, then excludes Bolt/Bomb. Lich.hurt rejects ANY causing Lich, including another boss or clone.

Generic deflect executes callback, then setOwner(argument), then onDeflection. setOwner(null) is a no-op. Player/AIM/TF parry with nonnull owner transfer ownership. Bolt.hurt redirects using causing entity look, but only transfers if DIRECT entity is Living; indirect arrow damage alone does not transfer (the earlier generic onHit may already have done so). Later-phase Lich callback sets owner=Lich temporarily: a prior nonnull Player/Lich owner is restored by outer deflect; an initially ownerless projectile keeps the new Lich owner. Native projectile owner UUID serialization is inherited by Bolt/Bomb/Wand.

Phase2 and3 with zero shields both admit ordinary source identities into super.hurt; killing all minions is NOT a prerequisite for HP damage. Teleport gate and causing-Lich rejection still apply. BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY can skip shield/clone/teleport gates but still cannot skip causing-Lich rejection; native subsequent gates remain. Native exact244 LivingEntity checks invulnerable/client/dead/fire-resistance, incoming event, shield, freezing/helmet changes, cooldown, armor/magic/absorption, pre/post hooks and death handling. True hurt need not mean positive HP loss.

Generic deflect executes callback, then setOwner(argument), then onDeflection. setOwner(null) is a no-op. Player/AIM/TF parry with nonnull owner transfer ownership. Bolt.hurt redirects using causing entity look, but only transfers if DIRECT entity is Living; indirect arrow damage alone does not transfer (the earlier generic onHit may already have done so). Later-phase Lich callback sets owner=Lich temporarily: a prior nonnull Player/Lich owner is restored by outer deflect; an initially ownerless projectile keeps the new Lich owner. Native projectile owner UUID serialization is inherited by Bolt/Bomb/Wand.

Native main/clone phase1 and main phase2 attacks launch owner-bound Bolt from body offset at speed0.5/inaccuracy1; gravity0.001. Server admitted Living impact requests custom lich_bolt6, ignores return and broadcasts/discards. Block collision discards. Pickable radius1; ignoreExplosion=true. Later phases return deflection before onHit for tagged projectile with owner Player/Lich/null; another Living owner is not in that deflection predicate. The projectile remains alive after deflection; lastDeflectedBy suppresses repeated callback on the same entity but still suppresses onHit.

Custom lich_bolt6 and lich_bomb radius2 use armor/Wolf-armor bypass, projectile, witch-resistant and NeoForge magic tags; Bomb additionally explosion, Bolt additionally shield-break. twilight_scepter6 uses projectile/magic/shield-break but NOT normal armor bypass. Damage scaling WHEN_CAUSED_BY_LIVING_NON_PLAYER affects Player recipients (Peaceful0, Easy min(x/2+1,x), Normal x, Hard1.5x); it does not rescale a Lich target before shield threshold. Explosion damage = float((q*q+q)/2*7*4+1), q=(1-distance/4)*exposure, NO integer floor; outer radius and nonzero direction gates remain. actual_behavior: getPhase: clone OR shield>0 =>1; else reserve<=0 AND countMyMinions()<=0 =>3; otherwise2. No HP threshold defines the three phases. countMyMinions scans AABB(x,y,z,x+1,y+1,z+1).inflate(32,16,32), master identity==this; no explicit alive filter. Nearby owned minions outside that box do not keep phase2 active.

At1->0 getPhase immediately becomes2 if reserve>0 or owned minion count>0; otherwise3. Default fresh Lich has reserve9, so phase2. No immediate HP damage, forced HP write or forced teleport is performed by shield break. Phase1 goal stops and despawns clones when goal scheduling observes loss of phase1; phase2 equips Zombie Scepter. Bossbar switches to HP on its next update.

MASTER_LICH UUID presence defines clone even if master unresolved; getter shield0 but phase1 and normal hurt immunity. Default cap2 from attribute; tracked UUIDs resolved to Lich with getMaster()==this. Phase1 canUse phase1/tickCount>20/target!=null. Main synchronizes cooldown/cloak to clones, fires itself and all resolved clones at cooldown0/range<30; type choice nextInt(3)>0 gives next Bolt2/3 else Bomb1/3, cooldown100. At60 it teleports and on success requests at most one clone. Clone spawn uses LOS candidate, copies target/home/cloak, initial cooldown60+rand(3)-rand(3). During its active uncloaked goal an orphan seeks nonclone master with capacity nearby; absent/dead/non-phase1 master discards clone. Main goal stop/death despawns clones. Clones have real projectiles but no independent normal main firing branch.

Phase2 goal only nonclone, acts while uncloaked with target. At attackCooldown%15==0 and server reserve>0/count<3, attempts spawn then decrements reserve even if LOS position/addFreshEntity fails. Native finalized MOB_SUMMONED LichMinion is Zombie subclass with master reference, no default equipment/loot pickup. Hard baby chance nextInt(100)<=20 while babyCount<minion_count/4 (default permits up to3 successful babies), otherwise adult. Missing/dead master seeks nearby nonclone count<3 then native kill if unresolved; master field is not custom-saved. Super-hurt success from ANY causing Lich grants Speed200/amp2 and Strength200/amp1, restores prior target via lastHurtByMob; false gives no buff. Ordinary Zombie melee uses effective ATTACK_DAMAGE, source mob_attack, inherited burning barehand successful-hit ignition; buffs are native effects. Pop goal: nonclone damaged, popCooldown0 and visible tagged Mob nearby; after20..39 held-scepter countdown and uncloaked/server, discard first visible poppable then heal2, cooldown40. Absorb goal: HP<max/2 and own nearby minions>0; after countdown/uncloaked, discard first owned minion then heal its current HP, no LOS test or hurt-success requirement. These discard/heal operations create NO DamageSource and are not player Lifedrain Scepter damage. Normal heal hook/clamp remains. Pop tag includes skeletons,zombie,enderman,spider,creeper,swarm_spider and removes #c:bosses. Inherited Zombie behavior remains: registered Zombie attributes (base HP20, attack3, armor2, speed0.23), baby speed modifier+0.5 total; native finalization randomizes reinforcement chance, knockback/follow range and possible leader HP/door modifiers, so20 is not a universal finalized minion HP. Sun exposure ignites8s unless headwear protects. Barehand burning successful melee can ignite for2*int(effectiveDifficulty) seconds at chance0.3*effectiveDifficulty. Hard, mob-spawning-enabled successful hurt can spawn ordinary Zombie reinforcements after native chance/space/player-distance checks; these are not LichMinion and do not consume/count the Lich reserve. Underwater600ticks then conversion300 (native predecrement completion) can convert to ordinary Drowned through loader conversion hooks, losing LichMinion type/count. Native ZombieGroupData allows baby jockey handling; minion spawn calls addFreshEntity, not an independent guaranteed passenger-add path. No default equipment population does not suppress the separate native calendar/headwear and attribute-finalization branches. These inherited behaviors are pinned to exact244, not treated as new Twilight status types.

actual_behavior: Before normal melee, target must be Living and isBlocking. Exact244 isBlocking requires active nonempty use item, SHIELD_BLOCK ability and use elapsed>=5; no facing/source-angle test is added by Naga. With movement state CHARGE, victim server velocity receives (1.5*vx,0.5,1.5*vz), Naga receives(-1.25*vx,0.5,-1.25*vz), using original Naga motion. ServerPlayer gets durability request5 on current use item, then registered play-to-client MovePlayerPacket whose handler adds(3*vx,vy+0.75,3*vz) to client motion. Do not add those server/client vectors into one guaranteed resulting velocity. Naga then requests ownerless minecraft:generic2 on itself, ignores its return, plays block sound, enters doDaze and returns false without ordinary victim melee. Thus false does not mean no self damage or no movement. Self recoil can be rejected by its existing hurt cooldown yet daze still starts. Native durability/Unbreaking/creative rules remain;5 is requested durability, not guaranteed loss.

actual_behavior: Naga constructs12 NagaSegment objects; each TFPart extends NeoForge PartEntity<Entity>, retaining a final parent reference and the parent EntityType/world. They are Entity, not LivingEntity, and have no HP/armor/effect pool. Parent getParts always returns all12; exact244 tracking inserts/removes all into the part map, and world entity queries append intersecting parts. Client recreate assigns parentId+i+1; TF part data synchronizes positions/dimensions/data. Native interaction lookup uses getEntityOrPart; ordinary reach/world-border/attack hooks still apply. TFPart.isPickable always true; inherited Entity.canBeHitByProjectile is isAlive && isPickable. NagaSegment.is(entity) accepts itself or parent, but the inspected world query uses identity and does not deduplicate by parent.

NagaSegment.hurt forwards the SAME DamageSource and amount*2F/3F to parent.hurt when !isInvisible; returns parent result. It neither calls own super.hurt nor subtracts local HP. Multiplication/division occur before parent invulnerability, incoming event, armor, Resistance/protection, absorption and shared hurt cooldown. This is a fixed segment-hit reduction, not a head damage cap or projectile immunity. Two-thirds applies to bypass-tagged sources too; parent source-specific rejection remains. Source direct/causing entities are unchanged and checked against home bounds at the head.

Each parent tick calls tick on every part BEFORE repositioning it. NagaSegment tick, when !isInvisible, queries its current AABB. Only entity.isPushable candidates call collideWithEntity. It first invokes recipient.push(part), independently of hurt; for a Living recipient other than ANY Naga, when parent !isDazed and !isDeadOrDying, it then requests minecraft:mob_attack2, or6 if recipient instanceof Animal. Source direct/causing=parent Naga, not the part. Result ignored; no LOS, target, team/owner test, bespoke cooldown or weapon/enchantment post-attack call. Multiple overlapping segments can attempt in one parent tick; recipient native invulnerability normally rejects equal later requests. Native collision push checks same vehicle/noPhysics/sleep and position, and does not use the damage-return gate. Nonpushable entities receive neither this push nor contact hurt. Dazed/dead parent stops contact damage, but not the preceding push.

activate sets size2x2 and own invisible flagfalse; deactivate sets size0x0 and own flagtrue. However TFPart.isInvisible returns PARENT.isInvisible, and NagaSegment does not override it. Consequently local deactivation does not make the hurt/contact !isInvisible predicate false while parent visible. All12 remain returned/moved; zero-sized boxes still can intersect a containing AABB and projectile selection inflates hitboxes, so loss is not a proven absolute untargetability/contact-disable guarantee. Parent Invisibility suppresses all segment forwarding/contact regardless their local active flags. This is a resolved installed-code discrepancy, not REVIEW_REQUIRED or a fix. Native generic Entity isAlive only tests removal; dead parent alone does not mark parts removed until parent cleanup.

Every parent tick: update segment count, super.tick, then for each of12 tick/contact followed by position. Leader=head for first, previous part thereafter; normalized existing separation plus head/leader facing straightenForce=0.05+0.5/(i+1), or0 if head dead. Final adjacent offset length2; in-wall part adds vertical correction before normalization. This changes real contact geometry, not just renderer animation. Native part push(D,D,D) does not forward movement to head and next positioning can overwrite displacement. Head isPushable=false prevents ordinary collision shoving, not hurt knockback/manual pushes. Incoming LivingEntity knockback retains registered KR0.25; explicit Naga velocity writes do not read that attribute.

Generic Entity queries/AoEs can include head plus multiple parts and make separate forwarded requests; LivingEntity-only AoEs exclude the parts. No Naga-wide attack-ID deduplication exists. Native piercing-arrow ignored IDs are per hit entity, so head/parts are separate candidates, bounded by piercing and collision/return handling. Forwarded requests share head invulnerableTime/lastHurt: equal/lower during>10 is rejected unless BYPASSES_COOLDOWN, larger admitted request contributes only excess over prior amount. A later head hit can therefore add the difference after a reduced segment hit; do not multiply full damage by13. A successful ordinary nonpiercing arrow discards. Parts are not Living, so native arrow potion/post-hurt/knockback callbacks that require Living target do not automatically run on parent. Native Player attack routes successful item.hurtEnemy to the part parent, but enchantment post-attack still receives the originally hit entity; a legitimate sweeping Living-only query may additionally hit head if geometry/eligibility permits.

When N drops old->new, parts indices[new,old) receive deathCounter=(old-i)*12 and remain active-sized until their countdown reaches0. Thus lost parts can continue their actual contact during staged loss. Completion makes particles/sound, resets parent.deathTime=0 and deactivates size0. Growth calls activateBodySegments for ALL indices<new, repositioning them near head; it does not clear existing part deathCounter, so a previously scheduled countdown can later deactivate a reactivated part. No independent severed-part life/damage pool. Parent removal server-side kills all12. Naga server removal waits deathTime>=124 (BaseTFBoss), with segment countdown completion resetting that counter; corpse duration is therefore not always exactly124 after lethal HP loss. HP0 still activates native dead hurt rejection; presentation/deferred removal is not extra HP or mandatory per-segment killing.

actual_behavior: Naga.isInvulnerableTo ordering: nonnull causing entity outside home -> true; nonnull direct entity outside home -> true; IS_EXPLOSION -> true; else super. Home uses floored block positions relative to valid same-dimension restriction point, inclusive |dx|<=46, |dy|<=7, |dz|<=46; invalid/missing home returns true for within-home. No own-position test is added to this damage predicate. Ownerless/directless environment bypasses only the entity-position checks. Thus an inside projectile from an outside owner still fails. These early home/explosion rejections precede super and have no BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY exemption. Registered EntityType fireImmune=true rejects IS_FIRE through native Entity invulnerability; installed fall_damage_immune tag similarly rejects IS_FALL. Normal native invulnerability event can affect that later superclass decision. Naga also overrides isInLava false, not universal immunity to all unnamed damage. No Naga projectile/magic whitelist, flat cap, daze-vulnerability multiplier, shield resource or HP-phase admission threshold exists.

Admitted head damage uses exact244 LivingEntity pipeline: invulnerability/client/dead/fire-resistance checks; incoming event; shield/freeze/helmet changes; invulnerableTime>10 rejection or excess; normal armor/toughness, Resistance and protection, absorption, pre/post events/death. No Naga cooldown reset or special short iframe. Naga.hurt only acts after true super return: resets ticksSinceDamaged=0, and if isDazed adds (int)original method argument to damageDuringCurrentStun. This integer accumulator is not actual HP loss; body reduction has already happened, but armor/absorption/cooldown excess have not changed this argument. Server AI forces CIRCLE when accumulator>15 and resets it then only; it is not reset by entering/leaving each daze, so subthreshold totals can carry between dazes. ForceCircle changes state/counter, and daze flag clears when CIRCLE tick executes.

actual_behavior: MovementPattern requires target and both self/target in home. Default/stop state CIRCLE counter15, clockwisefalse; stop does not itself clear DATA_DAZE/CHARGE/STUNLESS. Goal MOVE/LOOK, default requiresUpdateEveryTick=false; native Mob schedules it on full selector ticks, generally alternating ticks. State counter advances only when navigation done, using postdecrement (counter--<=0 transitions); while path active it waits or stops a stuck path. These counters are NOT fixed wall-clock attack seconds. Circle clears daze/charge (which clears stunless), uses radius12/14 alternating, radius16 when counter2 and rotation0.1 instead of1 when counter1. CandidateY=min(head.minY,targetY). Intimidate stops/looks, sets forward input.1 and counter +=15+randInt10. One calculation picks stunless with randomFloat*.75 < clamp(.75-HP/maxHP+difficultyId*.05,0,.5), giving probability threshold/.75 capped2/3. It is a choice probability, not a50% cap or hard HP phase.

Intimidate transition flips clockwise; if target.minY>head.maxY selects CRUMBLE else charge. Crumble counter20+randInt20, then charge. Charge/STUNLESS counter2 sends navigation to target-relative radius5/rotationPI at speed multiplier1.5, sets DATA_CHARGE; no independent rush DamageSource/damage bonus. CIRCLE uses speed1.0. Custom move control DAZE sets strafe xxa0; CHARGE or INTIMIDATE multiplies strafe by.8; other states INCLUDING STUNLESS_CHARGE use cos(tickCount*.3)*.6; native MoveControl may further set movement. These are real movement inputs, not decorative body animation. doDaze sets state/nav-stop/counter60+randInt40 but DATA_DAZE only sets during DAZE tick; DATA_CHARGE then clears. doCircle counter +=10+randInt10, forceCircle resets10+randInt10; neither immediately clears synced flags. DAZE blocks normal head melee/body damage when bool set, but collision push/externally applied velocity remains; no MobEffect or universal immobilization is created.

CRUMBLE tick calls crumbleBelowTarget(2) and(3). Grief+target needed, int(target.minY)>int(head.minY). For each range r, dx/dz=int(target coord)+rand(r)-rand(r), dy=targetY-rand(r)+rand(r-1); ifdy<=floor substitutes targetY. Helper permission as above, destroys with drops; no bespoke direct damage or LOS requirement. Any later fall damage is native environment, not Naga damage. Combat targeting clears when target distanceSquared>6400 or either outside home; native player target selector also checks home, retaliation remains native. Every20ticks with valid home and headY<homeY-5, teleport to integer homeXYZ and stop navigation. This is positional recovery, no teleport damage/invulnerability/refill. Path shortcut advances nodes while horizontal distance<4*headWidth (normally8), not a body-contact damage radius.

actual_behavior: customServerAiStep, gated by EventHooks.canEntityGrief and loaded box: x/z head BB±.75; y floor(minY+(shouldDestroyAll?1.01:.5)) to floor(maxY+1). Leaves are destroyed with no drops; other blocks only if charging OR head outside home and EntityUtil.canDestroyBlock succeeds. NagaSmashGoal canUse horizontalCollision+grief; server start uses same XZ with y min+1.01 to maxY (no+1); leaves OR charging/outside-home helper rule. Leaves short-circuit the helper hardness/container/per-block test, though the outer grief and loaded-region gates remain. Helper requires hardness>=0 and<50, nonair, no Container block entity, block.canEntityDestroy and uncanceled LivingDestroyBlockEvent. Default loader block permission for Naga allows, but custom blocks can override. Grief event defaults to mobGriefing and is externally alterable. These destroy real obstacles/support and pressure combat navigation; they are not extra direct damage.

CRUMBLE tick calls crumbleBelowTarget(2) and(3). Grief+target needed, int(target.minY)>int(head.minY). For each range r, dx/dz=int(target coord)+rand(r)-rand(r), dy=targetY-rand(r)+rand(r-1); ifdy<=floor substitutes targetY. Helper permission as above, destroys with drops; no bespoke direct damage or LOS requirement. Any later fall damage is native environment, not Naga damage. Combat targeting clears when target distanceSquared>6400 or either outside home; native player target selector also checks home, retaliation remains native. Every20ticks with valid home and headY<homeY-5, teleport to integer homeXYZ and stop navigation. This is positional recovery, no teleport damage/invulnerability/refill. Path shortcut advances nodes while horizontal distance<4*headWidth (normally8), not a body-contact damage radius.

effects.display_name: Axing melee and Minotaur axe sprint modifier
actual_behavior: Minoshroom inherits BaseTFBoss, not Minotaur behavior; registerAttributes reuses Minotaur attributes: HP120, movement0.25, base ATTACK_DAMAGE2 (native attribute default), KR0.5. FinalizeSpawn invokes native Mob finalization, ordinary random armor population, then equips diamond_minotaur_axe and requests ordinary spawn enchantments. Diamond tier attack bonus3 + axe parameter6 supplies +9 MAINHAND attack; settled unenchanted total11. Equipment updates apply native attributes; the axe attack-speed modifier -3.2 does not set mob AI cadence. Armor is not guaranteed zero: native population probability0.15*specialDifficultyMultiplier and equipment/enchantment rolls remain. Minoshroom weapon enchantment chance0.25*specialMultiplier, armor0.5*specialMultiplier. Axe gold enchantability is22, inherited durability1561 for diamond; no boss attack helper invokes ItemStack.hurtEnemy/postHurtEnemy, so ordinary axe wear is not charged by these mob hits. Native Player use of the same axe retains ordinary wear. Mainhand drop chance0 affects loot only. Installed multiplayerFightAdjuster=NONE is reused; no HP difficulty phase/regen/berserk threshold exists in Minoshroom.

Priority3 native MeleeAttackGoal(speed1,false) uses live target, path or melee reach, native LOS and melee AABB. Requires every-tick update; attack counter decremented then tested, resets20 before dispatch, independent of hurt success. It calls Minoshroom.doHurtTarget, which REPLACES ordinary Mob.doHurtTarget with EntityUtil.properlyApplyCustomDamageSource using twilightforest:axing, direct=causing=Minoshroom. Effective attack attribute passes native EnchantmentHelper.modifyDamage before victim.hurt, but the helper supplies ATTACKER itself as the affected Entity argument instead of victim (unlike Mob.doHurtTarget); target-dependent enchantment evaluation therefore uses that wrong entity context. This is separate from the later knockback helper, which receives the victim. True enables enchantment-adjusted ATTACK_KNOCKBACK*0.5, attacker XZ velocity*0.6 when extra knockback>0, and native post-attack enchantments. Helper mistakenly calls setLastHurtMob(attacker itself), not victim; preserve this installed distinction. False suppresses those success callbacks; true need not mean HP loss. It is a vanilla-like extended melee package, not an invented ordinary mob_attack CUSTOM_DAMAGE. Axing is physical-tagged with normal armor/Resistance/protection/absorption/cooldown.

Registered ToolEvents.addExtraAxeChargingDamage listens to LivingIncomingDamageEvent: uncanceled, server target, DIRECT entity Living and sprinting, nonempty MAINHAND instanceof MinotaurAxeItem => current newDamage +7. No source-type or successful-hurt test. Native Player difficulty scaling happens before this incoming hook, so settled unenchanted charging hit is D(11)+7, not D(18); Normal18, Easy13.5, Hard23.5 before downstream mitigation. A zero Player request (including Peaceful scaling) returns before the incoming event and cannot gain the bonus. Enchantments/other hooks can change the input. The same hook works for native Player sprint attacks (player_attack source) and a Minotaur that actually spawned with gold_minotaur_axe; a plain golden axe fails the item predicate. It is not a charge-only tag, and it does not require CHARGING synced flag. Return-false shield/cooldown rejection can occur after the bonus event.

Victim Player native blocking remains its own subsystem. Exact244 Living shield processing follows incoming callbacks; nonprojectile direct Living source invokes Player.blockUsingShield, then attacker.canDisableShield. The default IItemExtension returns instanceof AxeItem, inherited unchanged by MinotaurAxeItem/KnightmetalAxeItem. Native Player.disableShield sets current use-item cooldown100, stops use, broadcasts30. This does not depend on the boss melee helper receiving true. Blocking requires native warmup>=5, source direction and no BYPASSES_SHIELD; shield durability request is native1+floor(blocked shield damage) when>=3, subject to ordinary durability/creative/enchantment handling. Twilight adds no extra Minoshroom shield-disable mechanic. Slam bypasses shield and does not enter that block callback. Knight Phantom shield defense has its own early return described separately.

No Minoshroom hurt/isInvulnerableTo override, no source-specific projectile/explosion immunity, shield phase, damage cap, special iframe or HP gate. Registered type is not fireproof and no fall-immunity tag includes Minoshroom; normal native damage, optional equipment, Resistance and hooks apply. Boss membership prevents natural freeze buildup/helper Frosted admission, not every externally delivered IS_FREEZING damage request. Home radius20 uses valid same-dimension strict block-position distanceSquared<400 for priority5 AttemptToGoHomeGoal(speed1.25); it is navigation, NOT Naga-style source/owner admission or invulnerability. Higher-priority combat may preempt home movement. Targeting: native nearest Player(false mustSee), retaliation; no bespoke in-home target gate. BaseTFBoss refuses mounts/portals and fluid pushing; water slowdown1; Base lavaHurt ignites5 seconds then requests ownerless minecraft:lava4; only true hurt calls killLavaAround. It scans bossBB.inflate9 in unit steps, replaces exact Blocks.LAVA with AIR, without mobGriefing/hardness/container checks. Rejected cooldown/invulnerability prevents cleanup; true with absorption may still clean. This is environmental recovery, not fire immunity. Base death removal at20, normal dead hurt rejection; no resurrection/regen. Peaceful restores spawner at loaded valid home then discards; no far-away despawn. Native boss spawner range9 and nearest PlayerY<spawnerY+4, nonPeaceful, finalize then assign home. Spawn eggs without home are a different setup. Synced charge flags/counters and goal state are not custom NBT-saved; native HP/equipment/home persist.

Minotaur HP30/speed.25/native base attack2, dimensions.6x2.1, ordinary armor0 before external equipment, not fireproof. Goals Float0, Charge2(speed1.5,canBreak=false), native melee3(speed1), stroll/look, retaliation and nearest Player mustSee=false. No custom incoming hurt/phase/regeneration/death payload. CHARGING synced defaultfalse, getter/setter; aiStep only adds .6 animation speed while true. It is not a separate damage multiplier or saved charge resource. Native health/equipment persists; its own class has no NBT override. Finalize calls parent, then this override populates ONLY mainhand (not parent random armor), then native equipment enchantments.

Equipment roll uses entity.getRandom().nextInt10 (not the RandomSource argument), q=effectiveLocalDifficulty+1, result=(int)(roll/q). result0 equips gold_minotaur_axe, else vanilla golden_axe. Both registered tools have gold tier bonus0 + axe6 -> unenchanted settled native ATTACK_DAMAGE8; different attack-speed modifiers (-3.2 TF versus -3 vanilla) do not set mob goal cadence. The probability depends on local difficulty and exact integer truncation, not a fixed10 percent. Native equipment attributes/enchantments must have settled before fixture measurement. Neither weapon callback is automatically a Player hurtEnemy call for mob attacks.

Actual Minotaur AXING caller uses protected EntityUtil.properlyApplyCustomDamageSource, direct=causing=Minotaur, normal effective attack8 and helper enchantment quirks. On sprint, ToolEvents native incoming +7 applies ONLY current mainhand instanceof MinotaurAxeItem; vanilla golden axe has no bonus. Native Player difficulty scaling precedes +7: without enchantments ordinary8; TF axe sprint Normal15/Easy12/Hard19 before mitigation; plain gold sprint stays D(8). CHARGING flag alone is not predicate. Both axes retain native axe Player-shield disable100 and ordinary armor/shield processing; the extra incoming amount is independent of final hurt return. Do not duplicate protected axe/AXING implementation or relabel as Minoshroom slam.

Installed TF4.8.3345, raw Minecraft1.21.1 and exact NeoForge21.1.244. This section closes the previously partial Wraith/Minotaur body and actual RisingZombie delivery, reusing protected HAUNT/AXING/helper/charge semantics. Requests are not measured HP loss; no new source type, runtime or production change. Normal damage admission, native events, armor/shield/Resistance/protection/cooldown/absorption remain wherever not explicitly overridden below.

component_contracts.formula: Minoshroom inherits BaseTFBoss, not Minotaur behavior; registerAttributes reuses Minotaur attributes: HP120, movement0.25, base ATTACK_DAMAGE2 (native attribute default), KR0.5. Diamond tier attack bonus3 + axe parameter6 supplies +9 MAINHAND attack; settled unenchanted total11. Equipment updates apply native attributes; the axe attack-speed modifier -3.2 does not set mob AI cadence. Armor is not guaranteed zero: native population probability0.15*specialDifficultyMultiplier and equipment/enchantment rolls remain. Minoshroom weapon enchantment chance0.25*specialMultiplier, armor0.5*specialMultiplier. Axe gold enchantability is22, inherited durability1561 for diamond; no boss attack helper invokes ItemStack.hurtEnemy/postHurtEnemy, so ordinary axe wear is not charged by these mob hits. Native Player use of the same axe retains ordinary wear. Mainhand drop chance0 affects loot only. Installed multiplayerFightAdjuster=NONE is reused; no HP difficulty phase/regen/berserk threshold exists in Minoshroom.; Priority3 native MeleeAttackGoal(speed1,false) uses live target, path or melee reach, native LOS and melee AABB. Requires every-tick update; attack counter decremented then tested, resets20 before dispatch, independent of hurt success. It calls Minoshroom.doHurtTarget, which REPLACES ordinary Mob.doHurtTarget with EntityUtil.properlyApplyCustomDamageSource using twilightforest:axing, direct=causing=Minoshroom. Effective attack attribute passes native EnchantmentHelper.modifyDamage before victim.hurt, but the helper supplies ATTACKER itself as the affected Entity argument instead of victim (unlike Mob.doHurtTarget); target-dependent enchantment evaluation therefore uses that wrong entity context. This is separate from the later knockback helper, which receives the victim. True enables enchantment-adjusted ATTACK_KNOCKBACK*0.5, attacker XZ velocity*0.6 when extra knockback>0, and native post-attack enchantments. Helper mistakenly calls setLastHurtMob(attacker itself), not victim; preserve this installed distinction. False suppresses those success callbacks; true need not mean HP loss. actual_behavior: Priority1 GroundAttackGoal MOVE/LOOK. canUse postdecrements cooldown even when no target; eligible cooldown<=0, target distanceSquared2..9 inclusive, onGround, chance1/24 with LOS or1/20 without. Tick looks at captured target and sets MoveControl.operation WAIT (not a velocity reset or universal immobilization); postdecrement<=0 performs one slam and clears ground flag. Selection is block-position-centered AABB XZ +/-7.5, Y from blockY to blockY+3, intersects Entity candidates filtered Player, then recipient.onGround. Normally sprint has stopped; the general axe hook would still require actual sprint if another genuine path retained it. No block destruction by this slam. stop sets attackTick0/target null but does not itself clear ground flag, so interruption can leave a visual flag until another completion; no saved ground attack resource.

actual_behavior: PhantomWatchAndAttackGoal has no flags, canUse targetnonnull, default goal scheduling. With live target: lookAt(10,500); requires sensing LOS, postdecrement attackTime<=0, distance<2 and vertical BB overlap; resets20 before doHurtTarget, ignores return. Counter decreases only with live visible target (range test follows decrement); successful uninterrupted retry after21 visible goal calls, not fixed20 game ticks. Attacks can occur in any formation if eligible. Knight.doHurtTarget uses the same custom helper as Minoshroom with twilightforest:haunt direct=causing=Knight: attribute/enchantment damage with ATTACKER-as-affected-Entity in modifyDamage, success knockback/post-enchantment, erroneous lastHurtMob=self. HAUNT is magic-tagged, NOT armor-bypassing. Registered ToolEvents.doKnightmetalToolLogic at incoming, uncanceled/server/direct Living/nonempty mainhand: sword OR pick and target armorValue>0 adds int(2*armorCoverPercentage) to CURRENT newDamage if cover>0, else+2. Native cover=nonempty armor slots/total slots; quarter-covered target therefore adds0, half1, full2, while armor attribute without worn pieces adds2. Axe with armorValue==0 SETS newDamage=ORIGINAL damage+2 (can overwrite earlier hook changes), otherwise no bonus. Armor test is recipient before mitigation; no bypass. These hooks also apply to genuine native Player tool attacks; they do not run for ownerless ThrownWep sources. Player difficulty scaling precedes hook. Axe uses ordinary native Player shield disabling as described above; sword/pick do not gain it.

actual_behavior: Only PhantomThrowWeaponGoal in ATTACK_PLAYER_ATTACK with target and ticksProgress%4==0. Default goal scheduling and formation counter determine cadence; no unconditional every4 game-tick promise. Axe role creates NEW ThrownWep owned by boss, fresh plain knightmetal_axe, defaultdamage6 and gravity0.001, shoot speed0.75/inaccuracy1. Origin body-facing offset1, Y+height*.82; aims XZ to target and Y uses target minY+halfheight minus bossY+halfheight (not originY). Pick role emits8 fresh projectiles at45-degree increments, horizontal initial directions, radius1/Y+height*.82, speed0.5/inaccuracy1, setDamage3,setVelocity(.015) (the latter is GRAVITY, not launch speed), fresh knightmetal_pickaxe. No held-stack consumption, durability, pickup ammunition, enchantment copying or throw inventory pool. Sword emits none. Native ThrowableProjectile drag0.99 air/.8 water and configured gravity apply.

ThrownWep extends TFThrowable/ThrowableProjectile, retains native owner reference for collision but creates TFDamageTypes.getDamageSource with NO entity arguments. Therefore direct=null, causing=null, no explicit source position for BOTH thrown_axe6 and thrown_pickaxe3. Pickaxe identity selected only by synced item exactly knightmetal_pickaxe; every other item defaults AXE. Native canHitEntity checks recipient.canBeHitByProjectile and owner/root-vehicle until leftOwner. Accepted server onHitEntity excludes ANY KnightPhantom and exact current owner; no other team/Living-only gate. It calls hurt and ignores result. No weapon enchantment damage/post-effect, Knightmetal incoming bonus, owner-based Player difficulty scaling or directional native shield block, despite projectile retaining owner. Types are IS_PROJECTILE and physical; armor/Resistance/protection/projectile protection/absorption/cooldown remain. No armor/shield bypass tag; missing source position itself prevents ordinary directional shield block. Missing direct Projectile means normal Living knockback direction uses no projectile reference. onHit calls inherited entity/block callback then server smoke event/discard unconditionally even when hurt false or target is excluded. Other Knights therefore consume a colliding throw without HP damage. No piercing/multi-hit/pickup/return/reuse mechanic.

Exact244 Throwable tick offers ProjectileImpactEvent before hitTargetOrDeflectSelf; cancellation prevents onHit and discard. TF native timed parry applies to ITFProjectile, server, external parry mod absent (accepted installed scan), actual blocking, use elapsed<=configured40 and native blocking warmup>=5. AIM_DEFLECT transfers owner to blocker and cancels impact, independently of the later ownerless damage request; reflected projectile still cannot damage ANY KnightPhantom, and later source remains direct/causing null. Source-independent parry can work where ordinary ownerless directional shield block cannot. ThrownWep is pickable, pickRadius1, but not in REDIRECTABLE_PROJECTILE; inherited Entity.hurt false and no own hurt override means ordinary Player melee is not a proven bat-back path. Inherited projectile-on-projectile redirect only targets tagged projectiles; a throw can redirect a genuine tagged Lich Bolt via inherited Projectile.onHit but this does not reopen Lich review. There is no ThrownWep save/load override: inherited Projectile saves owner/leftOwner/hasBeenShot; item/gravity/projectileDamage are NOT saved. Reloaded pick becomes empty-item AXE source, damage6/gravity.001, while owner UUID persists. Synced data is not NBT persistence. No custom lifetime counter; normal impact/removal/environment rules remain.

actual_behavior: Native boss spawner attempts6 Knights in60-degree radius4 ring; generic range9 plus nearestPlayerY>spawnerY-2 and nonPeaceful. Finalize, assign same GlobalPos home, setNumber(i), add entity; spawned increments only on add success, spawner remains until6 successes. spawned is not custom NBT-saved; partial failure/reload is not a transactional unique six-member group. Hard gives OFFHAND knightmetal_shield only to i=5, before initialization/numbering. getNearbyKnights is class query in own BB.inflate64 with LivingEntity.isAlive and includes self; no group UUID, team, owner, shared home requirement, or six-member cap. Multiple encounters within range can mix; membership is local and geometry-dependent. Each has independent HP35, formation/counter/charge position. Lowest current number in observed list leads normal formation selection; ties can each qualify, no unique shared lock. updateMyNumber copies another number0 home, fills smaller/duplicate indices, tracks maximum known count for bossbar only. Death postmortem renumbers survivors only when BaseTFBoss.shouldSpawnLoot (doMobLoot) permits postmortem; later switchToFormation also renumbers. Group bossbar aggregate/totalKnownKnights is presentation, not a shared HP resource, reserve, heal or damage redistribution.

Initial HOVER90. Formation durations in GOAL update counts: LARGE clockwise/anticlockwise180, SMALL90, four axis traversals180, WAITING10, ATTACK_PLAYER_START50, ATTACK_PLAYER_ATTACK50. Default requiresUpdateEveryTick=false so native selector normally ticks these on alternating game ticks; all-time counters are not seconds. Update goal always active, no flags: sets noPhysics from OLD progress%20!=0, increments, transitions if>=duration, then sends wanted destination speed2 if FLAG_CHARGING else1. Lowest-number leader when ordinary formation ends randomly chooses smallCW2/8,smallCCW2/8, each axis1/8, broadcasts to all observed noncharging Knights including self, then if none charging chooses RANDOM nearby Knight for ATTACK_PLAYER_START. It is not rotating turn order. Large-circle enum destinations are implemented but not selected by this native random chooser; no fabricated large-circle producer is claimed. START -> ATTACK; ATTACK with>1 live near ->WAITING; WAITING after10 copies nearbyKnights[1] formation/progress (query order, not a proven leader lookup), else START. Broadcast does not reset an already charging member. Local lists/goal order, simultaneous transitions and reload mean no globally guaranteed exclusive attacker.

With nearby list size1 at ATTACK end, code first randomly creates sword/axe/pick, THEN switchToFormation(ATTACK_PLAYER_START) calls updateMyNumber. Since there are no OTHER living Knights, nums.isEmpty => setNumber(0), which immediately replaces chosen weapon with sword. Final native survivor therefore reenters sword role; do NOT claim lasting random weapon cycling. A freshly solitary Knight also leaves totalKnownKnights=Integer.MIN_VALUE in that empty-neighbor branch, causing customServerAiStep to retry updateMyNumber each time and reset sword; this field is not an ammunition/shared-health resource. Losses can change surviving weapon roles through renumbering. No regeneration or HP transfer after deaths.

Knight overrides knockback: ignores supplied strength and native KR/hook method, sets impulse, halves current XYZ motion, adds fixed horizontal -ratio/sqrt(xRatio^2+zRatio^2)*.2 and Y+.2, caps Y at.4. There is NO zero-direction guard, so (0,0) produces undefined/NaN horizontal arithmetic; no runtime consequence fabricated. Ordinary native collision push still depends on noPhysics separately. At HP0 native dead damage rejection remains. Base death tick increments; Knight removal requires deathTime>=88 AND no nearby living Knights. At>=18 size set0; corpse can wait while others live, not share their HP. hasYetToDisappear controls initial rise .015 and rendering; last permitted postmortem resets nearby dead Knights deathTime1 and syncs packet, then IT_IS_OVER=true. No resurrection. MobLoot=false skips that reset/renumber postmortem; eventual88/no-live removal still governs. Peaceful spawner/discard and ordinary BaseTFBoss restrictions remain. NBT saves TotalKnownKnights, MyNumber, Formation, TicksProgress, IsItOver plus native HP/equipment/home. Read calls setNumber (replaces weapon), private switchToFormationByNumber (NO setChargingAtPlayer), then restores ticks; FLAG_CHARGING and transient +/-7/armor modifiers are NOT saved/restored here. Constructor defaults false/HOVER/noPhysics; on reload saved attack formation can initially run with inactive dimensions/no charge boost and absent inactive armor modifier until normal switchToFormation reconciles state. chargePos not saved, home setter initializes it to home; watch/guard counters restart. No universal immediate state reconstruction claim.

actual_behavior: Knight.hurt first calls native isDamageSourceBlocked and returns false with sound if true, BEFORE superclass invulnerability/incoming/shield damage pipeline. This branch does not damage shield, dispatch LivingShieldBlockEvent or blockedByShield/axe-disable callbacks. Actual guard requires native blocking item+warmup>=5+facing/source position, no shield bypass and no piercing-arrow exemption failure. Native Hard sixth Knight is the proven offhand-shield producer. PhantomWatch goal: live target; if offhand instanceof ShieldItem, formation!=ATTACK_PLAYER_ATTACK and private isGuard =>startUsing OFFHAND, else stop. Counter increments while guardCoolDownTime<=180, reaching181 then flips off; off phase decrements to0 then flips on. Formation can suppress use while counter still runs. Timers are goal calls and pause without live target; no health/enrage gate. Item KnightmetalShield only extends native shield abilities/repair/durability1024, no damaging spikes. Outside early block, Knight.isInvulnerableTo rejects exact IN_WALL or superclass; own rule has no bypass-invulnerability exemption. Normal projectiles/explosions/magic/HP requests otherwise admitted under normal rules; no noncharging invulnerability. noPhysics and visually absent body are not damage immunity. Fall-damage-immune tag and empty fall callback both preserved. Skeletons membership gives native undead potion inversion/Poison-Regeneration immunity and boss freeze buildup exclusion, not universal magic immunity. Not fireproof. Armor state and standard hurt cooldown/Resistance/protection/absorption remain; no cap or fresh iframe override.

Actual guard requires native blocking item+warmup>=5+facing/source position, no shield bypass and no piercing-arrow exemption failure. Native Hard sixth Knight is the proven offhand-shield producer. PhantomWatch goal: live target; if offhand instanceof ShieldItem, formation!=ATTACK_PLAYER_ATTACK and private isGuard =>startUsing OFFHAND, else stop. Counter increments while guardCoolDownTime<=180, reaching181 then flips off; off phase decrements to0 then flips on. Formation can suppress use while counter still runs. Timers are goal calls and pause without live target; no health/enrage gate. Item KnightmetalShield only extends native shield abilities/repair/durability1024, no damaging spikes. Outside early block, Knight.isInvulnerableTo rejects exact IN_WALL or superclass; own rule has no bypass-invulnerability exemption. Normal projectiles/explosions/magic/HP requests otherwise admitted under normal rules; no noncharging invulnerability. noPhysics and visually absent body are not damage immunity. Fall-damage-immune tag and empty fall callback both preserved. Skeletons membership gives native undead potion inversion/Poison-Regeneration immunity and boss freeze buildup exclusion, not universal magic immunity. Not fireproof. Armor state and standard hurt cooldown/Resistance/protection/absorption remain; no cap or fresh iframe override.

actual_behavior: Hydra is BaseTFBoss, base HP360/movement0.28, registered root dimensions16x12 and fireproof. Installed multiplayerFightAdjuster=NONE remains pinned. Seven containers each hold one 4x4 HydraHead and five 2x2 HydraNecks; body6x6, two legs2x3 and tail6x2 give46 Entity parts. They are TFPart/NeoForge PartEntity, NOT LivingEntity, with no independent HP. First three containers start IDLE, remaining four DEAD. Root is not pickable; actual parts are pickable and forward the same DamageSource to the parent. NeoForge part IDs/world queries/native Player reach and impact hooks are reused. HydraPart.hurt does not itself reject inactive dimensions or markedDead: parent state admission is decisive. Only head hits add that head counter; neck/body/leg/tail hits affect parent HP without adding a head counter. Multiple queried parts or piercing-arrow part IDs can cause multiple attempts, but all forward to ONE parent cooldown/HP pipeline. A rejected arrow hit can still increase a head counter; nonpiercing arrow callback/discard follows the returned bool, not the counter. No seven independent HP pools or guaranteed multiplied HP damage. Positioning caveat from complete Hydra methods: aiStep explicitly ticks body and both legs (not tail), repositions body and tail (not legs), and container tick repositions head/necks. No dedicated leg reposition call exists; do not assume all46 parts form correctly placed independent body hitboxes. No runtime positioning result or fix is claimed.

Exact part admission order: server IN_WALL first attempts terrain clearing; then reject causing OR direct entity equal to Hydra; reject either equal to any own part; identify the exact head or reject a neck belonging to DYING/DEAD head; compute parent-to-causing-entity distanceSquared (-1 if absent); reject >400, or >600 when DIRECT entity is HydraMortar; reject DYING/DEAD head; forward to BaseTFBoss.hurt. Head interpolated mouth openness strictly>0.5 forwards original amount; every other part/closed head forwards Math.round(amount/8F). Closed-head/body armor is this fixed pre-pipeline reduction, not armor attribute or a bypassable armor tag. Open-head counter adds (int)original amount; closed-head counter adds rounded amount, AFTER hurt regardless of its bool or actual HP. Admission rejects before forwarding add nothing. Native server/alive/fire-resistance/events/shield/cooldown/armor/Resistance/protection/absorption then decide HP. True alone resets ticksSinceDamaged. Parent hurt called directly accepts only BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY; part forwarding deliberately calls super.hurt and avoids that root gate. Hydra.isInvulnerableTo returns false for exact hydra_mortar, otherwise superclass (fireproof included); this exception does not remove later Living fire-resistance, dead/client/event/cooldown checks and does not bypass the root hurt gate. Own unreflected mortar is rejected by owner identity even with the correct type. Source owner range, not projectile range/home radius, governs distant attacks; ownerless source skips range. BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY does not override the preceding part self/range/state gates.

actual_behavior: Each head has integer damageTaken, initially0; addDamage truncates each float request independently, never reads actual HP loss. Server AI schedules DYING only when !isDead and damageTaken>120 (strictly greater, not >=120), ends current action and sets respawnCounter140. It also picks one random current DEAD head whose counter==-1 and schedules140 if any; there is no eighth head. DYING counts as dead for attacks/hurt and active-count, but isActive means state!=DEAD, so DYING is saved as active. DYING lasts70; respawn countdown only decrements while current DEAD. A newly recruited already-DEAD head therefore starts its140 countdown immediately, while the killed head waits through DYING first. At --counter<=0, schedule BORN, reset damageTaken0, end current action and set counter-1. Then BORN20 -> ROAR_START10 -> ROAR_RAWR50 -> IDLE. No parent heal in head regrowth and no fire/cauterize predicate. All seven can ultimately be active. Bite remains restricted to head indexes0..2 and requires active-count>2; all heads can flame/mortar. Loss can reduce concurrency and suppress bites until regrowth; it is not an HP-threshold phase.

Container server tick: tick head/necks; update difficulty; activate nondead zero-width parts or deactivate DEAD parts; advance respawn, then ++ticksProgress and transition when>=ticksNeeded, then position/facing/execute/sounds. A transition sets progress0, so attack runs on entry. Explicit pending next state wins automatic successor; endCurrentAction sets progress=ticksNeeded for next tick. Initial active IDLE uses60/60 (transitions next tick); enum IDLE duration10 thereafter. Durations: BITE_BEGINNING40 -> BITE_READY80 -> BITING7 -> BITE_ENDING40 -> ATTACK_COOLDOWN80 -> IDLE; FLAME_BEGINNING40 -> FLAMING100 -> FLAME_ENDING30 -> cooldown; MORTAR_BEGINNING40 -> MORTAR_SHOOTING25 -> MORTAR_ENDING30 -> cooldown; DYING70 -> DEAD20 loop; birth sequence as above. Secondary attacks replace automatic cooldown with IDLE and clear their flag. Mouth is clamped interpolation previous-state to current-state, not a binary attack flag: idle/cooldown/dead/born/ending0, flame/mortar beginning0.75 and active1, bite beginning0.25/ready1/biting0.2, roar-start0.25/roar1. Thus vulnerable >0.5 includes portions of windup/end/roar, not all attack ticks; for example BITING starts open and closes during seven ticks. Death marks head at1 and five necks at10/20/30/40/50, then each marked part deactivates at its deathTime20. Size/state/mouth/current+last and names are synced through existing multipart data; not independent health.

ticksSinceDamaged increments in aiStep; custom server AI heal(1) only when counter>1000 and divisible5: first1005, then every5 until forwarded hurt true resets0. Native heal event may alter/cancel; setHealth clamps max; no DamageSource and no head-counter reset from healing. Root bypass damage does not use that reset branch. NBT stores NumHeads BITMASK (not numeric count), HeadNames, native HP/home; only set bits queue IDLE/end action on load, with NO clearing of constructor first-three defaults. Thus dead first-three heads are reactivated on reload even with clear saved bits; DYING saved bits also return idle. Per-head damage, pending action/progress/respawn counter, target, regen counter and secondary flag are unsaved. actual_behavior: Every server BITING tick (seven state ticks) queries head BB.inflate(0,1,0), all Living except parent; no target-identity/LOS/team filter. Before hurt, a currently blocking Player: if use item not on cooldown, request112 durability via native hurtAndBreak; then add cooldown200 to current use item, stop use, send additive MovePlayerPacket(-head.cardinalX*0.5,0.15,-head.cardinalZ*0.5). This pre-hurt control is independent of damage acceptance, and does not check shield facing or source shield bypass. Damage request48, twilightforest:hydra_bite, direct=causing=Hydra, not head; entity-type exclusion argument only affects death text. Afterwards regardless bool another Player push packet uses Y0.1 (so blocking branch sends both); nonPlayer code calls knockback(-cardinalX,0.1,-cardinalZ). Preserve this argument-order quirk: first arg is STRENGTH, not X. Default strength is1 only when cardinalX=-1; 0 or-1 otherwise yields no positive native knockback absent hook changes. RatioX0.1/ratioZ=-cardinalZ; ordinary knockback hook/KR then apply. Physical source retains armor/Resistance/protection/absorption/cooldown; preemptive stop-use normally prevents ordinary shield block for that attempt. Repeated attempts share recipient cooldown; seven requests are not seven48 HP hits. No success-only enchantment callback in this attack.

actual_behavior: FLAMING runs one server look-target query per tick for100 state ticks, not one hit per rendered flame. Track target coordinates toward entity by normalized step0.04 (Hard0.1); facing max5 degrees yaw. Ray source=(headX,headY+1,headZ), view vector, endpoint30. Block.OUTLINE/Fluid.ANY clip supplies a BlockPos even for MISS; candidate AABB is headBB MOVED by look*(per-axis min(30,abs(head-coordinate-hitBlock-coordinate))) and inflated3, NOT a swept30-long box. Candidate pickable entities exclude head and only necka/b/c; nearest ray/AABB intersection wins, using full30 endpoint without comparing entity intersection against block-hit distance. Self Hydra/any own HydraPart and fire-immune winner are rejected AFTER selection, so they can occlude a later eligible target. This implementation is not a cone, block ignition, multiple-target sweep, or a proven strict block-occluded ray. For eligible target request19 hydra_fire direct=causing=Hydra; only hurt true calls igniteForSeconds(3). Normal armor/shield/Resistance/protection/absorption/shared cooldown and fire immunity/Fire Resistance apply. Fire tag is not projectile or explosion. Later burning is native on_fire, a separate source, not repeated hydra_fire; no terrain ignition here.

actual_behavior: MORTAR_SHOOTING progress0/10/20 creates three HydraMortars per state sequence. Owner=parent Hydra via ThrowableProjectile(owner). Position=head look*3.5 plus headY+1; head velocity is zeroed; shootFromRotation(head,pitch,yaw,-20,0.5,1) supplies upward pitch offset and inaccuracy. If current target nonnull and head COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE LOS fails, set megaBlast true (no target => ordinary). Gravity0.05, native throwable movement/collision/impact hook/deflection; type0.75x0.75 fireproof, pickable radius1.5. onHit override dispatches its own entity/block callback and omits superclass Projectile.onHit redirection of a struck projectile. Entity hit server requires owner nonnull; if target another mortar, requires target.getOwner().is(owner), not different owner (ownerless target dereference has no null guard); reject target.is(owner) or own HydraPart while owner Hydra. Allowed entity hit detonates; disallowed hit has no discard. Ordinary block top hit sets vertical speed0 and onGround=true; other faces detonate then still set onGround. Mega detonates on any block. Ground tick calls immutable velocity.multiply(.9) but discards its result: no extra .9 damping is applied. Server fuse starts80 and postdecrements only onGround, detonating when old<=0 (81 grounded checks). No airborne lifetime fuse.

detonate FIRST calls native Level.explode(source=mortar,radius ordinary0.1 or mega4,fire=canEntityGrief(level,mortar),interaction=MOB); THEN loops entities in mortarBB.inflate(1) without owner exclusion or LOS. Non-fire-immune entities OR any Hydra/HydraPart receive18 twilightforest:hydra_mortar direct=mortar, causing=current owner (nullable); only true ignites5 seconds. Finally discard regardless accepted HP damage. There is no separate on-collision18 hit before explosion:18 is the post-explosion nearby query, and ignores explosion exposure. Native explosion source is minecraft:player_explosion when direct mortar and Living indirect owner both exist (despite the type name, original Hydra owner qualifies), otherwise minecraft:explosion. Standard radius/exposure damage formula and separate knockback apply. The18 request is fire-tagged, NOT IS_EXPLOSION or IS_PROJECTILE and NOT armor bypass; Explosion Protection applies to preceding explosion, Fire Protection to the custom18, ordinary Protection/Resistance/absorption/cooldown remain. Explosion may consume cooldown before18, so never sum full damage automatically. Mega block resistance min(original,0.8) except COMMON_PROTECTIONS; native explosion block/event/mobGriefing rules still apply. Ordinary radius0.1 can damage very-near entities; it is not an inert cosmetic explosion. A reflected mortar splash can attempt multiple Hydra parts and counters; closed parts round18/8 to2, open heads forward18, owner-distance<=sqrt600 and shared parent cooldown still apply.

Entity tag REDIRECTABLE_PROJECTILE includes HydraMortar. Native Player.attack after attack-interaction admission invokes AIM_DEFLECT and RETURNS before target.hurt; direction becomes player look normalized (speed1), owner=Player. This normal reflection does NOT clear onGround, extend fuse, use speed1.5 or toggle mega. An incoming projectile using superclass Projectile.onHit can first redirect a tagged mortar to its owner. Separately, a genuine source reaching HydraMortar.hurt calls super.hurt but ignores that return: on server any nonnull causing entity shoots along its look at1.5/inaccuracy0.1, clears onGround, adds20 fuse; only Living causing entity replaces owner; returns true regardless amount. Ownerless/client returns false. Native incoming arrow may therefore run both redirection and hurt callbacks; callers that override onHit may omit the first. Mortar is NOT ITFProjectile; pinned parryNonTwilightAttacks=false means TF timed shield parry does not catch it, despite its Twilight registry name. No custom save methods: inherited projectile saves owner/leftOwner/shot plus Entity position/motion/onGround, but fuse and mega reset80/false on reload. Ordinary Player reflection after reload remains tag-based. Preserve these distinct native paths; do not fabricate a reflected DamageSource.

actual_behavior: UrGhastAttackGoal canUse requires target and !tantrum, default Goal scheduling (not requiresUpdateEveryTick); timers count goal tick calls, generally alternate game ticks via Mob.serverAiStep. Start resets attack/prev0; in distanceSquared<4096 and sensing LOS timer pre-history then increment; warn10, fire20 if still !tantrum, reset-40. Out-of-range/LOS decrements only positive timer; stop clears charging. Native nearest-Player mustSee target goal follow128 is separate from firing range64. Each volley spawns3 UrGhastFireball(power1) owner=UrGhast; center aims target midpoint from boss midpoint, spawn look*8.5 plus midpointY+2; two side shots same spawn except no+2 and offsetX/Z plus (randFloat-randFloat)*8. No special damage attribute/enchantment scaling of16. Registered actual entity type is inherited minecraft:fireball, not a Twilight fireball registration.

UrGhastFireball overrides onHit and does NOT call LargeFireball.onHit or Projectile.onHit. Entity-hit server only, except any AbstractHurtingProjectile target: request16 damageSources.fireball(this,owner), then EnchantmentHelper.doPostAttackEffects regardless hurt bool, then explode(source=null,radius power1,fire=canEntityGrief(owner),interaction=NONE) and discard. Excluded projectile target does not explode or discard in that branch. Block-hit calls inherited block projectile callback, then same null-source explosion/discard; its method has no own server guard (normal AbstractHurtingProjectile tick runs both sides); authoritative HP remains server. No extra inherited6 hit or second inherited MOB explosion in live custom path. Impact source minecraft:fireball direct=projectile/causing=owner; null owner uses minecraft:unattributed_fireball factory direct=causing=projectile. Fire/projectile tags, ordinary armor/directional shield/Fire Resistance/Resistance/Fire or Projectile Protection/absorption/cooldown. No direct target ignite call (projectile burning itself is distinct). Ownerless explosion is minecraft:explosion direct=null/causing=null: native difficulty scaling is ALWAYS, not owner-dependent; no source position for ordinary directional shield, and Explosion Protection applies. NONE keeps blocks but fire=true can still set eligible fire in native finalizeExplosion; do not call it no entity damage/no fire. Explosion and16 are distinct attempts sharing cooldown; enchantment callback and explosion are unconditional on first return.

Native AbstractHurtingProjectile starts movement normalized aim*.1, adds normalized current movement*accelerationPower(.1), then inertia.95 (.8 water) each tick, no mortar gravity. It discards on server when known owner removed or chunk absent; native owner/leftOwner/ray collision/event admission retained, excludes noPhysics targets. UrGhastFireball.shoot method is not used by the native volley producer. Fireball.hurt returns false, so ordinary attack damage does not itself reflect. Minecraft fireball is REDIRECTABLE_PROJECTILE: Player.attack early AIM_DEFLECT transfers owner/direction; incoming native Projectile.onHit can redirect it too. Live custom instance implements ITFProjectile, so pinned TF timed blocking5..40 ticks can AIM_DEFLECT and cancel impact when external shield-parry mod absent. DeflectedByPlayer resets acceleration.1; other generic deflection halves acceleration. Reflection leaves custom16 payload and null-source explosion unchanged. Native Entity save stores minecraft:fireball ID; registry factory recreates LargeFireball on reload, NOT UrGhastFireball (no custom registered type/loader restoration). Owner/leftOwner/shot, native motion, acceleration and ExplosionPower1 persist, but post-load impact becomes vanilla6, inherited projectile redirection/onHit flow, source=fireball MOB explosion, and no ITFProjectile marker for TF parry under parryNonTwilightAttacks=false. Client spawn likewise uses registered vanilla type. This is a static proven factory distinction, not measured runtime damage.

No shared HP with minions. isReflectedFireball requires DIRECT instanceof LargeFireball AND causing instanceof Player, no exact DamageType check. Such source skips UrGhast.isInvulnerableTo entirely; otherwise exact IN_WALL, any IS_FIRE, or superclass reject. Native Living dead/client/Fire Resistance/events/cooldown/armor/Resistance/protection still apply. Unlike Ghast minions, no reflected-hit1000 branch: a live reflected custom fireball requests16 (or1.6 in tantrum), subject to mitigation. Ordinary nonfire sources otherwise accepted; no explicit home range gate. Native fireball collision additionally rejects noPhysics targets; a trapped UrGhast may therefore be passed over even when a reflected source would satisfy hurt admission. isOnFirefalse, isPushablefalse and knockback no-op; native separate explosion additive velocity is not that method. Fall tag immunity/empty checkFallDamage; no portal/mount/native Base restrictions. No real combat teleport.

damageUntilNextPhase field initializer10 is immediately reset to18 by constructor setInTantrum(false); threshold18 from spawn, not10. Every hurt first divides input by10 if tantrum, snapshots HP, calls super.hurt, then computes actual oldHP-newHP. Server subtracts that actual loss only if hurtTime==hurtDuration, alive after hit and inTrapCounter<=0. Bool is returned but NOT tested for phase accumulation. Shared cooldown higher-damage follow-ups whose hurtTime no longer equals hurtDuration can lose HP without counting; zero-loss/rejected/fully absorbed hits subtract0. No fixed duration or HP percentage. Counter<=0 toggles phase and resets18, discarding overshoot; fatal damage does not toggle. Enter tantrum sets flag/reset, spawns visualOnly lightning near radius18 and calls trap minion producer. Exit toggles flag/reset. setInTantrum(false) called by traps resets18 every trap tick even if already false. NBT saves only inTantrum plus inherited data; load resets progress18, trap timer/cry/timers/path/trap list unsaved. Tantrum reduction precedes the incoming event and native mitigation, so it is not armor and not avoided by armor-bypass tag.

component_contracts.formula: UrGhast extends BaseTFBoss, NOT Ghast; reuses CarminiteGhastguard attributes only: HP250, follow128, KR1, ordinary default armor0; root14x18 fireproof. No shared HP with minions. isReflectedFireball requires DIRECT instanceof LargeFireball AND causing instanceof Player, no exact DamageType check. Such source skips UrGhast.isInvulnerableTo entirely; otherwise exact IN_WALL, any IS_FIRE, or superclass reject. Native Living dead/client/Fire Resistance/events/cooldown/armor/Resistance/protection still apply. Unlike Ghast minions, no reflected-hit1000 branch: a live reflected custom fireball requests16 (or1.6 in tantrum), subject to mitigation. Ordinary nonfire sources otherwise accepted; no explicit home range gate. Native fireball collision additionally rejects noPhysics targets; a trapped UrGhast may therefore be passed over even when a reflected source would satisfy hurt admission. isOnFirefalse, isPushablefalse and knockback no-op; native separate explosion additive velocity is not that method. Fall tag immunity/empty checkFallDamage; no portal/mount/native Base restrictions. No real combat teleport.; damageUntilNextPhase field initializer10 is immediately reset to18 by constructor setInTantrum(false); threshold18 from spawn, not10. Every hurt first divides input by10 if tantrum, snapshots HP, calls super.hurt, then computes actual oldHP-newHP. Server subtracts that actual loss only if hurtTime==hurtDuration, alive after hit and inTrapCounter<=0. Bool is returned but NOT tested for phase accumulation. Shared cooldown higher-damage follow-ups whose hurtTime no longer equals hurtDuration can lose HP without counting; zero-loss/rejected/fully absorbed hits subtract0. No fixed duration or HP percentage. Counter<=0 toggles phase and resets18, discarding overshoot; fatal damage does not toggle. Enter tantrum sets flag/reset, spawns visualOnly lightning near radius18 and calls trap minion producer. Exit toggles flag/reset. setInTantrum(false) called by traps resets18 every trap tick even if already false. NBT saves only inTantrum plus inherited data; load resets progress18, trap timer/cry/timers/path/trap list unsaved. Tantrum reduction precedes the incoming event and native mitigation, so it is not armor and not avoided by armor-bypass tag.; Native Base death handling with Ur isDeathAnimationFinished deathTime>=90; dying getDeltaMovement returns(0,-.03,0), no revived HP. die calls Base and adds visualOnly lightning at center; first30 smoke then loot-transfer particles are cosmetic. Ur boss spawner inherits range9 and adds nearest Player Y>spawnerY-4; Hydra spawner range50. Both native spawners set home after normal finalize, and Peaceful Base restoration/discard remains. Unrestricted spawn eggs without home are alternate delivery fixtures, not guaranteed trap availability. Ur health/home and inTantrum persist; residual threshold, trap cache, timer, flight progress and consumed-minion history do not. No DamageType other than ghast_tear is constructed directly by UrGhast; its fireball and trap use vanilla sources.

effects.display_name: Tantrum tear damage and minion lift
actual_behavior: Custom server AI while tantrum clears target, cries every20..49 ticks (audio only), and each entity tickCount%10==0 performs real damage/control. Query box=UrGhastBB.move(0,-16,0).inflate(0,16,0): same XZ footprint, Y from boss.minY-32 through boss.maxY, NOT a spherical radius or falling-projectile collision. All queried Players with canSeeSkyFromBelowWater at blockPosition request3 ghast_tear, direct=causing=UrGhast. No team/range/LOS-to-boss check; native Player creative/spectator/mitigation still decide. Every CarminiteGhastling in same box receives additive push(0,1,0), with no sky/owner/minion/hurt-success test. Tear source has physical, BYPASSES_ARMOR (transitively shield), DAMAGES_HELMET, NO_KNOCKBACK and AVOIDS_GUARDIAN_THORNS; not projectile/fire/explosion. Any head-slot item invokes native helmet durability processing and scales amount*.75 before cooldown/remaining mitigation (Normal3 ->2.25, not guaranteed HP); Resistance/protection/absorption remain. Boss tear particles have no Entity projectile or hurt callback here. Client tantrum sets TFWeatherRenderer.urGhastAlive; tickRain raises local rain visual by.1 capped1, clears flag, otherwise decays.02; combines max with world rain. No server weather/timer alteration. All summoned lightning has visualOnly=true: no real lightning damage/fire. Particles/rain/audio are separate from server tear checks.

actual_behavior: Entering tantrum and insufficient-ghast flight-path wrap both call spawnGhastsAtTraps: shuffled cached traps, first min(2,size). Each location spawns visualOnly lightning at y+4; loop declares24 tries but increments spawns unconditionally and breaks at6, so exactly6 attempts per selected trap, not24 retries or six guaranteed successes. Position X/Z=trap+(randDouble-randDouble)*4, Y=trap+randDouble*8. Create CarminiteGhastling, makeBossMinion then EventHooks.finalizeMobSpawn(MOB_SUMMONED), call instance checkSpawnRules then addFreshEntity/spawnAnim. Exact inherited Mob.checkSpawnRules returns true; this call does NOT call static CarminiteGhastling.canSpawnHere placement predicate or checkSpawnObstruction. Finalize/add hooks may still prevent actual addition. Static spawn predicate is separately notPeaceful and (MOB_SUMMONED or darkEnough) and checkMobSpawnRules, but not this direct producer gate. No boss reference, UUID owner/master, team, target assignment, shared pool or on-boss-death cleanup is assigned. Native ghastling default HP10/follow16; makeBossMinion sets isMinion=true,wanderFactor.005 (normal4), base maxHP6 then setHealth(max). No scaling from UrGhast HP.

CarminiteGhastling extends CarminiteGhastguard extends native Ghast; its own nearest-Player mustSee selector acquires target, no target inheritance from UrGhast. shouldAttack rejects EXACT Items.PUMPKIN in helmet (not carved pumpkin); within3.5 requires target LOS, otherwise target view-dot >1-.025/distance AND LOS. GhastguardAttackGoal uses same20/-40 default-scheduled counter and64-range LOS; emits ONE ordinary LargeFireball, owner=ghastling, inherited explosionPower default1; after shot chance1/6 clears target. Vanilla projectile requests fireball6 then unconditional post-enchantment; inherited onHit explodes with projectile source/MOB regardless hurt, unlike live boss projectile16/null/NONE. Ghastling is fireproof/fall-immune, normal mitigation otherwise; native Ghast reflected-LargeFireball+Player hurt branch requests1000 then returns true regardless super result (UrGhast does not inherit this branch). Flight uses Ghast collision-checking move control with tiny minion wander, not Ur noClip controller. isMinion saved; loading true calls makeBossMinion AFTER super native HP load, restoring full6 HP and wander. No saved master or despawn bond; native Ghast/monster despawn applies. Minion flag does not restrict trap charge, tantrum lift, boss consumption or local enough-ghasts count.

actual_behavior: Every server custom AI queries ALL CarminiteGhastlings in bossBB.inflate(1), no owner/minion/team/LOS/liveness predicate added. For each: spawnAnim, discard, then heal(2). It is native LivingEntity.heal (event can cancel/change; HP must>0; setHealth clamps maximum), not direct boss setHealth, no DamageSource and no SHP system. Consumption remains even when heal canceled/full HP. Does not lower/reset damageUntilNextPhase or derive heal from consumed HP/maxHP. Any native CarminiteGhastling in range qualifies, not only this boss spawns. Tantrum upward push can change later delivery to consumption box but is not healing itself.

actual_behavior: Inactive non-debug ticking trap scans new AABB(blockPos).inflate(10,16,10) for CarminiteGhastlings with deathTime>0, stores unique entity references in dyingGhasts; no minion/master/kill-credit/LOS/sky filter. Same corpse is counted once per trap, can charge multiple traps; list is not pruned on corpse removal. isCharged requires size>=3. Only neighborChanged server, inactive+charged+hasNeighborSignal activates block state and queues event0; charge reaching3 alone does not call activation, so an actual neighbor notification is required. actual_behavior: Server scans GHAST_TRAP POIs on firstTick or tickCount%100 at valid home else current position, radius64, any occupancy, requires canSeeSky(trap.above), sorts distance; append unseen. Every60 removes cached positions whose block is not GHAST_TRAP or no sky. FlightGoal MOVE builds/shuffles trap path at canUse; if no traps, four cardinal offsets20 plus center. Start picks next point, Y+=20 when restriction point nonnull, speed parameter1, sets noPhysics=false. On path index wrap, if no trap has>=4 queried CarminiteGhastlings in centered unit box inflated(8,16,8), spawnGhastsAtTraps; count includes nonminions and has no master filter. Traps are not required to be charged/active for spawning/path. Constructor noPhysicstrue; trap also sets true, next flight start can restorefalse. NoClipMoveControl adds normalized displacement*.1*speed each cooldown2..6-style postdecrement interval, no clearance or zero-distance guard. Travel applies water.8/lava.5/air or ground friction*.91 without ordinary fall acceleration, no climb. Tantrum and trap do not install a new speed or halt flight goal; tantrum clears attack target. inTrapCounter set20 and custom AI decrements while clearing target; ordering after native goal tick can matter. Path/counters restart on reload; no teleport.
